title: 2 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 6
description: Ten questions on 2 Chronicles 6: Solomon's prayer at the dedication of the temple, from the bronze platform to his requests for forgiveness.

questions.text: According to Solomon, where had Yahweh said he would dwell?
questions.explanation: Solomon said that Yahweh had said he would dwell in the thick darkness.

answers.text: On the top of Mount Sinai

questions.text: Which city did God say he had now chosen, that his name might be there?
questions.explanation: God said he had chosen Jerusalem, that his name might be there, and David to be over his people Israel.

questions.text: Who did Yahweh tell David would build the house for his name?
questions.explanation: Yahweh told David that he would not build the house, but his son who would come out of his body would build it.

answers.text: David himself, in his old age
David's son who would come out of his body
The elders of all the tribes

questions.text: What had Solomon made and set in the middle of the court to stand on?
questions.explanation: Solomon had made a bronze platform and set it in the middle of the court; he stood on it and knelt before the assembly.

questions.text: What did Solomon say heaven and the heaven of heavens cannot do?
questions.explanation: Solomon said that heaven and the heaven of heavens cannot contain God, how much less the house he had built.

questions.text: When the sky is shut up and the people turn from their sin, what did Solomon ask God to send on the land?
questions.explanation: Solomon asked God to hear, forgive and send rain on the land given to his people for an inheritance.

questions.text: Which of these is in Solomon's list of troubles in verse 28?
questions.explanation: Verse 28 lists famine, pestilence, blight or mildew, locust or caterpillar, and enemies besieging the cities.

questions.text: Why did Solomon ask God to do all that the foreigner calls to him for?
questions.explanation: Solomon asked it so that all the peoples of the earth may know God's name and fear him, as Israel does.

answers.text: So that the foreigner would bring gifts to the temple
So that the foreigner could become a priest
So that all the peoples of the earth may know his name and fear him
So that Israel would make peace with Egypt

questions.text: What did Solomon say about men and sin in verse 36?
questions.explanation: In verse 36 Solomon said that there is no man who doesn't sin.

answers.text: There is no man who doesn't sin
Only the wicked sin against God
A king cannot sin before God

questions.text: With what did Solomon ask that God's priests be clothed?
questions.explanation: Solomon asked that God's priests be clothed with salvation and that his saints rejoice in goodness.
